proved_relative_to_retained_inputs: If an order-four element belongs to two Suzuki subfield faces of degrees d,e, their point-root centres intersect in order 2^gcd(d,e).
Cyclic face intersection and an order-four middle rotation force gcd(d,e)=1.
For an odd middle rotation the intersection of its face centralizers is exactly its cyclic subgroup, of order the gcd of the two centralizer orders.
For coprime face degrees the middle rotation has order four or five.
remaining: Two genuine proper Suzuki subfield faces: odd middle rotations, and the coprime-degree order-four/order-five alternatives, are not excluded. F003 main rank-four exclusion remains unresolved.
diagnostic_boundary: Separate mutable trace experiments are not part of this written proof or export closure.
